headline: Dress any character in any item
intro: Your items now travel further. Share them across characters, shape your wardrobe your way, and set up characters and moves with more choices than before.

highlights.title: Every character can wear shared items
highlights.text: Any shared item can now be worn by any character, the demo included. Tapping a shared item on the demo saves an editable copy and wears it there.

highlights.title: Manage wardrobe slots per character
highlights.text: You can now organize wardrobe slots inline for each character, and move saved items between equipment slots. Slot setups carry into exports.

highlights.title: New models and references for creation
highlights.text: New character now offers the Pro model and a Standard option with direction presets. You can also add optional character and item references to guide what gets made.

highlights.title: Keep walking while you click
highlights.text: In Top-down and Side-scroller, a walk held on the movement keys now continues when you click wardrobe tiles, tabs or toolbar buttons.

fixes.text: Studio now opens on the standing move, so worn items no longer look lost.
Copying items between characters with one body no longer drops standing views.
Downloads stay available for incomplete characters.
